device.name: XC7VX690T
device.bits_note: top-level bits = CRAM + BRAM + FF from AMD/Xilinx DS180 and UG470; DSP excluded (no Lee 2014 sigma)

CRAM.bits_source: AMD/Xilinx UG470 7 Series FPGAs Configuration User Guide, Table 1-1 Bitstream Length, device 7VX690T: Configuration Bitstream Length = 229,878,496 bits. DS180/UG470 do not publish a separate FAR-addressable CRAM cell count; this vendor configuration size is used as CRAM bits.

BRAM.bits_source: AMD/Xilinx DS180 7 Series FPGAs Data Sheet: Overview, Virtex-7 XC7VX690T Total Block RAM = 52,920 Kb. Conversion 52,920 × 1024 = 54,190,080 bits (same convention as Lee 2014 XC7K325T: 16,020 Kb × 1024 = 16,404,480).

FF.bits_source: AMD/Xilinx UG474 7 Series FPGAs Configurable Logic Block User Guide, Table 3 Virtex-7 FPGA CLB Resources, device 7VX690T, Flip-Flops = 866,400. Same CLB Flip-Flops figure in DS180.

DSP.ds180_source: AMD/Xilinx DS180, Virtex-7 XC7VX690T DSP Slices = 3,600
DSP.reason: Lee 2014 REDW Table 1 has no DSP heavy-ion Weibull; DSP is not included in N_SEU.

reference_rates_per_bit_day.source: Lee, Wirthlin, Swift, Le 2014 REDW Table 2: GEO, solar minimum, 100 mils Al (same Weibull parameters)
reference_rates_per_bit_day.note: Lee 的参照是 GEO（几乎没有地磁屏蔽）；本次是 MEO 20200 km / 55°，截止刚度 0.04–0.86 GV，预期与 GEO 同量级、略低。两者都是 GCR 太阳极小 + 100 mil Al。

dut_linear_reference.source: Lee, Wirthlin, Swift, Le, 2014 IEEE REDW Table 1 tested-device bits (DOI 10.1109/REDW.2014.7004595)
